content.title: FSLY Q3 Deep Dive: Security Growth and Cross-Sell Drive Upbeat Outlook
content.summary: Edge cloud platform Fastly (NYSE:FSLY) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 15.3% year on year to $158.2 million.
